write_behavior: none; every command emits canonical JSON to stdout and the root controller persists create-only bytes with apply_patch

execution_root.constraint: resolved contained directory strictly beneath successor_20260813

closed_world_layout.<slot>/rendered/<cell>.txt: exact frozen harness render storage when persisted
closed_world_layout.artifact_manifest.json: pw-r8-artifact-manifest-v2 exact inventory of every final run file except itself and validation_report.json
closed_world_layout.validation_report.json: pw-r8-run-validation-v2 exact binding of the reopened manifest, matrix terminal, and subject-call accounting

capture_envelope.binding: Verifier reconstructs the entire envelope from the only derived direct-appserver receipt; equality and key order are exact and the envelope binds the receipt storage bytes.
capture_envelope.nonconforming_calls: Capture envelope is still required. No replacement semantic capture is admitted.

commands.emit-capture: Derive the only legal capture envelope from the completed receipt.
commands.admit: Require exact frozen next cell, all earlier scores PASS, required deterministic artifacts valid, no later or terminal evidence, and only positive no-start controller invalids at the target.
commands.validate-cell: Bind receipt/capture/render, classify subject conformance, and invoke the harness stage scorer for permanent PASS or FAIL.
commands.validate-artifact: Recompute a deterministic stage and require byte-identical persisted storage.
commands.validate-controller-invalid: Validate a derived contiguous invalid receipt and report recreation eligibility only when every attempt at that cell has positive no-start and byte-identical frozen-input proof.
commands.path-terminal: Emit an honest subject FIRST_ATTEMPT_FAIL, CONTROLLER_INVALID_NO_START, CONTROLLER_INVALID_AFTER_START_OR_UNKNOWN, matrix-aborted ineligible, or complete-pass path terminal; a recoverable no-start attempt is constructibly terminal with zero credit.
commands.matrix-terminal: Recompute all path terminals, require persisted equality, enforce independent thread-ID and turn-ID uniqueness, distinguish controller-invalid matrices from subject-failure matrices, and emit honest accounting.
commands.call-accounting: Emit exact matrix-level expected, attempted, started, completed, PASS, FAIL, invalid-attempt, invalid-cell, no-start, after-start, unknown-start, missing, ineligible, retry, best-of, replacement, and unique-identity counts.
commands.artifact-manifest: After persisted matrix terminal and call accounting, emit the exact closed-world inventory of every final run file except artifact_manifest.json and validation_report.json.
commands.validation-report: After the manifest is persisted, reopen/recompute it plus matrix terminal and call accounting and emit their exact storage/payload bindings.
commands.reopen-matrix-terminal: After the validation report is persisted, reopen/recompute matrix terminal, accounting, manifest, and validation report and emit exact bindings for all four.
commands.qualify-two-runs: Require consecutive sequence 1 then 2, identical candidate freeze digest, two fully final-reopened complete-clean matrices, zero controller-invalid history, exact 582-call accounting, and globally disjoint threads and turns across both runs.

terminal_generation_order: run reopen-matrix-terminal without persisting another run artifact
manifest_self_reference_rule: artifact_manifest.json inventories every final closed-world run file except itself and validation_report.json; validation_report.json then binds and reopens the persisted manifest, matrix terminal, and accounting; final reopen validates both terminal artifacts.

permanent_fail_conditions: not exactly one assistant final message
not exactly one text content item
non-UTF-8 text impossible under receipt schema
stage response schema or semantic mismatch

causal_rules.no_start_recreation: only contiguous preserved invalid receipts with subject_call_started exactly false and byte-identical frozen input

terminal_rules.clean_path: all frozen cells completed and PASS plus byte-valid S90 bounded_causal_simulation_pass and zero controller-invalid receipts on that path
terminal_rules.failed_path: first valid subject FAIL is permanent and no later evidence may exist
terminal_rules.invalid_path: any controller-invalid receipt permanently excludes clean path credit; positive no-start and after-start-or-unknown have distinct terminal labels and exact attempt/cell counts
terminal_rules.clean_matrix: three COMPLETE_PASS paths, zero controller-invalid receipts anywhere, independently unique thread IDs and turn IDs, and qualification_clean_run_credit exactly 1
terminal_rules.invalid_matrix: any controller-invalid history has qualification_clean_run_credit 0 and a controller-invalid matrix label, with a mixed label only when valid subject FAIL evidence also exists
terminal_rules.failed_matrix: with zero controller invalids, valid honest terminal with exact calls, PASS, FAIL, missing, and zero retry/best-of/replacement accounting

two_run_finalization: Both runs must contain byte-valid artifact_manifest.json and validation_report.json and pass final reopen before qualification; whitelisted-but-unvalidated terminal files are forbidden.
nonclaims: This verifier is disposable and not a production security boundary.
A valid terminal applies only to the frozen throwaway fixture and candidate bytes.
One clean matrix is not two-run qualification.
